name: account-orchestrator
summary: Run many Claude Code accounts as one pool — live per-account usage, one account per project, and an automatic no-reload switch of a running chat before the limit.
install: curl -fsSL -o account-orchestrator.tar.gz https://github.com/primovera12/gnesis-vault/releases/latest/download/account-orchestrator.tar.gz && tar xzf account-orchestrator.tar.gz && cd account-orchestrator && bash install.sh
usage_prompt: Install account-orchestrator from the Gnesis Vault; gives each project its own account and auto-switches running chats before the limit.
